method: Call the frozen BudgetReservingAdmission pre-filter on synthetic public-only fixture states, record every admit/reject with class, demand, budget, lambda and reason, then independently recompute from saved calibration table in a fresh process. Verify tracing does not change the frozen decision or counters. No SAA, simulation, physics, solver, model, historical five-day rerun, or new scientific data.
strict_checks: all 54 fixture decisions, reasons and counter changes exact; source identities exact; independent implementation does not import traced module or frozen policy module
scope_limit: Narrow engineering interface for future newly registered requests. Does not recover missing five-day per-order logs, establish full live request, trained MaskCO attribution, or stable gain.
